text_block_list.text:
Hello? Is that you, ya li'l runts? Ya
watched the
race, yeah?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
I did my best, but the lady racing
against me was
real good too, right?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: She's the same as me.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Several nights after the spring Tenno
Sho...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Comin' in, Creek.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Oh, Tamtam! I'm so sorry for the other
day. My
emotions got the better of me...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
S'okay. What happens in a race stays in
the race.
Besides, I was the one who
provoked ya.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
I totally screwed up by sayin' what I did.
I fired ya
up so much, you became the
star.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Remember what I said in the waitin' room
before
the race?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
And I'll whomp that trainer lurkin'
behind ya so
bad they'll never be the
same.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
I shouldn't've said that. I was tryin' to
sabotage
your future.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
But I lit a fire under ya, and the kind
Creek was
gone.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс
Супер Крик
choice_data_list: What's she talking about, Супер Крик?

text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't have cared if you were just
trying to
provoke me, but...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: I couldn't let you hurt Trainer's future.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Because I will do everything in my power
to make
sure my trainer becomes the
best in the world.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: That's a dream that I won't budge on.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
It hit me when I saw your angry face
after the
race...
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
It was like my mom's face when she gets
angry.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
The face of somebody tryin' to protect
their kid
from some schmuck tryin' to
crush their dreams.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
I thought the two of you were a ditzy
duo, but I
was wrong.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
You're family. I never realized it, but
you're racin'
for somethin' just as
precious as I am.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for pickin' a fight. You two are
the real
deal.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Tamtam... I should be the one
apologizing, but
thank you for saying
that. ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Let's have dinner together!
You
haven't eaten yet, have you?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to call your mommy to let
her know,
okay?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Wait, my mom?! Ya don't gotta call her
when
she's all the way over in Osaka!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Sigh... What am I s'posed to do with ya?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
But I'll definitely join you for dinner!
Can't miss
out on your tasty cookin'!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
After a fun dinner together, Супер Крик
and
Тамамо Кросс are back to being
best friends.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Phew, thanks for the chow. Anyway, I'm
sure your
race against Oguri won't be as
scrappy as ours.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
She might be a li'l spacey, but you two
have fun
out there, yeah?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Hehe, okay! I'll do just that.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
The fierce look definitely doesn't suit
Super
Creek. I hope she has an amicable
race this time
around.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
